faqs.q: How do I track my order?
faqs.a: Open the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email, or go to Account > Orders and select the order. Tracking updates within 24 hours of dispatch.

You can return unused items within 14 days of delivery. Start a return from Account > Orders > Return item. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the item.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 6 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and is available in major cities.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
faqs.a: Orders can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of placing them. After that, the order is packed, so you'll need to return it once it arrives.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, and cash on delivery for orders under 5,000 rupees.

faqs.q: I forgot my password. What now?
faqs.a: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. Check spam if it doesn't arrive.
